post.originalText:
i don't know how to use CAD. i've never built a robot

last night opus 5.5 built me one anyway

> watched the free stanford robotics guide
> opened claude, typed one sentence: "design a working 6-joint robot arm i can build for $122"
> went to sleep
> woke up to this
> 6 joints. working gripper. every joint moving in a physics sim exactly like the real thing
> 0 lines of CAD written by me

companies pay robotics engineers $200K–$400K to do this

i did it with a $20 subscription and a free guide

next week i order the parts. the week after, it moves on my desk

the guide is in the article below. you're about 12 hours from your own
